🇮🇳🤝🇦🇷 Rotary Friendship Exchange 2026–27

Rotary Meets Local Leadership – Strengthening International Understanding

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown | District 3141, India
Rotary Friendship Exchange | District 4895, Argentina

As part of the Rotary Friendship Exchange 2026–27, the delegation from Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown, District 3141, visited the Municipal Office at América, Argentina, for an engaging interaction with local civic leadership.

🏛️ Meeting with the Mayor

The delegation had the privilege of meeting Mayor John Alviro Martínez and discussing the community service initiatives undertaken by Rotary in América, Argentina. The interaction provided an opportunity to share Rotary's approach to community development, social welfare and sustainable service, while highlighting the positive role Rotary clubs play in addressing community needs.

The meeting reflected the importance of collaboration between civic authorities and service organisations in creating meaningful and lasting community impact.

📺 Rotary District 3141 Featured on Argentine Television and Radio

A special highlight of the visit was the media coverage by Argentine television and radio, giving the visiting delegation an opportunity to share its Rotary journey and experiences with a wider audience.

The media representatives engaged the Indian Rotarians in an interactive question-and-answer session, exploring their Rotary activities, community projects and experiences during the Friendship Exchange. This exchange helped introduce the work and service philosophy of Rotary District 3141 to the Argentine audience.

🌎 Building Bridges Through Service and Communication

The visit was more than a courtesy call. It was an opportunity to build connections with local leadership, exchange ideas and showcase Rotary's commitment to service on an international platform.

The interaction with the Mayor and the media strengthened the visibility of Rotary's work and reinforced the value of international cooperation in promoting community welfare.

Rotary Friendship Exchange demonstrates that service has no borders—and that every conversation can open the door to new understanding, collaboration and friendship.

🇮🇳❤️🇦🇷 Two Districts • Two Countries • One Rotary Family
